IN RECENT RIGHT NECK OF FEMUR FRACTURE POST
Patient was brought to the emergency with complaints of breathlessness, laboured breathing and drop
of saturation at home - 70% on room air on 21/02/2025.
Patient had History of 5 days postoperative to right bipolar hemiarthroplasty patient had fever, HRCT
chest was done which was suggestive of small consolidation in the right lower lobe with GGOs= received
injection TARGOCID and ERTAPENEM. Patient had on and off fever at home. Non-weight bearing.
Known case of hypertension, with surgical history of right hip bipolar hemiarthroplasty done on
ICU SUMMARY:- 21/2/2025 to 23/02/2025 :- Patient was admitted to the ICU with the above said
complaints. Routine investigations were sent which showed raised WBC count of 12000, CRP 85.9, raised
di dimers (6.6), trop l' 352, serum creatinine 0.6. Patient was referred to Dr lancelot Pinto (pulmonology)
ABG was done suggestive of type 1 respiratory failure with a D- dimer of 6.6, on further evaluating CTPA
showed poster basal segmental Pulmonary Embolism, hence was started on LMWH and was later
switched to orali Apixaban. Bilateral lower limb venous doppler done suggestive of no deep vein
thrombosis. 2D echo 22/02/25 suggestive of normal LV, dilated LA, left ventricular ejection 55%, grade I
LVDD, mild MR, mild AR, mild TR, no PAH, no clot/vegetation, no pericardial effusion. Fraction patient
was stabilized and was maintaining saturation of 95% on room air.
Patient is now clinically stable with no more breathlessness. She is vitally and hemodynamically stable
and can be discharged with the following advice.
